concerns.text: Task T006 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but creates a single file `src/utils/logger.py`. Parallel execution could cause a race condition on that file, violating the `[P]` guarantee.
Task T007 is marked `[P]` yet writes the CLI entry point `src/cli/run_pipeline.py`. Concurrent runs would contend for the same file, making the parallel‑safe claim unsafe.
Task T008 is marked `[P]` but creates a single `Makefile`. Parallel execution may lead to nondeterministic file writes; this task should not be labeled `[P]`.
Task T098 extends the logger by appending fields to `pipeline.log`. Because it modifies the same log file written by earlier logger tasks, marking it `[P]` is unsafe.

Task T085 runs a sensitivity‑analysis loop that writes to `results/threshold_sensitivity_<species>.tsv`. The loop is marked `[P]` but all iterations write to the same output file, so parallel execution would cause write conflicts.
